description: The pie chart, titled "Categories," displays the distribution of different data types across six distinct categories, with each slice representing a category's proportion of the total. The largest segment, colored red, corresponds to "chat" and accounts for 41.2% of the total, with a raw count of 546,526. The second largest segment, in blue, represents "math" at 21.9% (290,496). The "tooluse" category, shown in green, makes up 11.6% (154,358). The "multi turn chat" category, in orange, constitutes 9.3% (123,615), followed by "code" in light purple at 9.0% (119,563). The smallest segment, in pink, is "instruction follow," representing 9.0% (91,460). The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that matches each category with its corresponding color and numerical value, and the percentage and label for each slice are clearly displayed outside the pie. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the largest, "chat," and appear to be ordered by decreasing size.
